decision.next_authorized_work: new D3-only static 13-of-16 weight-fit bridge-inclusive CPU contract; D0-D2 fixed A1-OSG

protocol_and_prior_ledger_reconciliation.m514_m523_order: source-event-major atomic 4/6/9-tap expansion without global reorder

p0.title: The 95-99% one-entry hit premise depends on an unmodeled destination reorder
p0.evidence: M1105/M1156 loops phase, destination and output block before source groups, while M514/M523 consumes one source event and atomically emits its 4/6/9 destination taps without reordering. M523 also explicitly lacks the M218/C2 weight-bank bridge.
p0.impact: The reproduced 1.932533x is an opportunity upper bound, not an executable M523-cycle result.
p0.resolution: Downgrade the result, forbid run-accumulator RTL, and require a charged bridge-inclusive contract.

p1.title: M712 already priced the same destination-pull collision
p1.evidence: All four contributor counts match exactly. With bitmap probes, optimistic grouping, dense commit and a 16-entry fully associative weight cache, D0/D1/D2 lose because 384/98/25 weight identities exceed 16; only D3 has 13/16 fit.
p1.impact: A duplicate full-PIDP RTL path is ruled out; only a statically selected D3 CPU fast-kill remains justified.

p2.title: The analytic 96-bit scan count is not an admitted cycle line
p2.evidence: 7,488,000 words and 89.856 MB quantify the minimum deterministic inverse-map reads, but compaction, conflicts and memory ports require the next CPU contract.
p2.required_caveat: Do not cite it as measured speedup.

p2.title: The positive selective ratios use different populations
p2.evidence: 1.368424x is sample0 all-four including diagnostic D1; 1.474346x and joint-fairness 1.214176x are the three-sequence D0+D2+D3 headline subset.

admitted: destination-major numeric reproduction and exact per-layer invariants
M1156 1.932533x as a free-reorder upper bound only
permission for a new D3-only static weight-fit CPU contract
